data.name: Bariqat
data.gender_notes: Bariqat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bariqat is a beautiful name derived from the Arabic root 'b-r-q', meaning 'lightning' or 'thunderbolt'. This name is mentioned in the Quran and carries a powerful and spiritual significance. It evokes the awe-inspiring power of Allah's creation and the energy and vitality that comes with it. The name Bariqat carries the meaning “Lightning, Thunderbolt” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bariqat usually hope their child will grow to embody lightning, thunderbolt and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of Allah's power and creation, inspiring awe and reverence.
data.etymology: Bariqat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lightning, Thunderbolt.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bariqat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
